book: A Court of Thorns and Roses
source_note: Beat summaries are written for this project (not book text). Chapter mapping verified by chapter headings and name mentions in the EPUB; later-chapter summaries are brief and should be re-checked before each milestone.

chapters.title: The Winter Hunt
chapters.summary: Starving, Feyre hunts deep in the snowbound forest. A giant wolf stalks the same doe; she kills it with her single ash arrow, then a second arrow through its eye, skins it and carries the doe home.
chapters.gameplay: Gimmick battle: the wolf (Andras). Optional caches in the forest.

chapters.title: The Cottage
chapters.summary: Home at dusk. The family's poverty, Father's ruined leg, Nesta's contempt, Elain's gift of paint tins, the vow to their dying mother, Nesta's suitor Tomas Mandray.
chapters.gameplay: Cottage hub. Dinner raises power to Tier 1. Relic: Elain's Paint Tins. Upgrade a card at the hearth.

chapters.title: Market Day
chapters.summary: The village market. Nesta faces down the Children of the Blessed. A mercenary overpays for the hides and warns of faeries crossing the wall. Isaac Hale. That night, a beast bursts through the cottage door.
chapters.gameplay: Village hub: sell hides, shop, optional talk with Isaac. Ends with the beast at the door.

chapters.title: A Life for a Life
chapters.summary: The beast demands the wolf's killer under the Treaty. Feyre confesses and chooses to cross the wall rather than die. Father: 'You go somewhere new—and you make a name for yourself.'
chapters.gameplay: Dialogue confrontation with choices (outcome is canon-locked).

chapters.title: The Crossing
chapters.summary: Feyre rides north on a white mare behind the beast. He puts her to sleep with magic; she wakes two days later at a hedge-bordered gate in Prythian.
chapters.gameplay: Night ride, then a cinematic crossing of the Wall. End of Milestone 1.

chapters.title: The Estate
chapters.summary: Arrival at a rose-veiled estate. The beast becomes a golden-masked High Fae; Lucien and Alis. Andras is named.
chapters.gameplay: Spring Court hub opens.

chapters.title: Terms of the Treaty
chapters.summary: Dinner and a cold welcome. The Treaty, the blight on Prythian's magic, and Feyre's plans to escape.

chapters.title: Gardens and Knives
chapters.summary: Feyre maps the gardens, steals a knife, and is given the run of the grounds.
chapters.gameplay: Power Tier 2.

chapters.title: Riding with Lucien
chapters.summary: Feyre learns of the Suriel. A ride with Lucien turns cold as something passes.

chapters.title: The Bogge
chapters.summary: The Bogge passes; Lucien warns her not to look. That night her father seems to wait at the hedges.
chapters.gameplay: Avoidance encounter: do not look.

chapters.title: The Puca
chapters.summary: Feyre runs into the woods after her 'father': a puca luring her to be eaten. Tamlin saves her.
chapters.gameplay: Possible side battle.

chapters.title: The Study
chapters.summary: Nightmares and night wanderings; Tamlin shows her the study.

chapters.title: Lucien's Knife
chapters.summary: Talk of the courts and the blight. Feyre asks how to trap a Suriel.

chapters.title: The Snare
chapters.summary: Following Lucien's instructions (birch grove, slaughtered chicken, double-loop snare, running water), Feyre catches the Suriel. The naga arrive.

chapters.title: The Naga
chapters.summary: Feyre fights the naga beside the Suriel's snare; Tamlin arrives and kills them.
chapters.gameplay: Gimmick battle: the naga (the snared Suriel is in play). Power Tier 3.

chapters.title: Molten Chocolate
chapters.summary: Recovery and a thaw between Feyre and Tamlin.

chapters.title: The Wounded Faerie
chapters.summary: A mutilated faerie is brought to the manor; Tamlin carries the dead out into the fields.

chapters.title: Lucien's Gift
chapters.summary: Lucien returns her knife and admits he hesitated when she was in danger.

chapters.title: The Gallery
chapters.summary: Paints arrive. The Attor slips through the garden and speaks of 'her'. Calanmai approaches.
chapters.gameplay: Stealth encounter.

chapters.title: Fire Night
chapters.summary: On Calanmai Feyre leaves her room. Faeries harass her until a stranger intervenes.

chapters.title: The Stranger
chapters.summary: Rhysand, then Tamlin after the Rite, wild and dangerous.
chapters.gameplay: Power Tier 4. Fade to black is not needed here; tension only.

chapters.title: Not Alone
chapters.summary: Feyre paints; Tamlin: 'That I'm not alone.'

chapters.title: Summer Afternoon
chapters.summary: A lazy afternoon in the woods; drowsy closeness.

chapters.title: Bark and Brass
chapters.summary: A bark-skinned servant at breakfast; the blight presses closer.

chapters.title: Dawn
chapters.summary: Tamlin is called to the borders; on his return, a kiss at dawn.
chapters.gameplay: Romance beat. Fade to black where needed.

chapters.title: Rhysand's Visit
chapters.summary: Rhysand visits; Amarantha is named; threats of Under the Mountain.

chapters.title: Thorns and All
chapters.summary: Tamlin sends Feyre away; she half-hears 'I love you … thorns and all.'
chapters.gameplay: Fade to black.

chapters.title: Farewell
chapters.summary: Feyre leaves Prythian in a gilded carriage, and wakes at a white chateau: her family, rich again, and the glamour's story of a dead aunt.

chapters.title: The Chateau
chapters.summary: Days in Elain's garden; Father among his gems; a walk to the old cottage, so small now.

chapters.title: What Nesta Knew
chapters.summary: Silver for the poor; Tomas and Isaac; Nesta saw through the glamour, and went as far as the Wall.

chapters.title: The Ball
chapters.summary: The ball, the Beddor fire, and the ride back over the Wall to an empty, wrecked manor.

chapters.title: Alis's Tale
chapters.summary: Alis tells the truth: Amarantha, the curse, the masks, the wolves. Feyre will go Under the Mountain.

chapters.title: To the Mountain
chapters.summary: The journey; the Attor finds her.

chapters.title: The Throne Room
chapters.summary: Amarantha's bargain: three trials or a riddle. Feyre is beaten.
chapters.gameplay: Power Tier 5 (a drop).

chapters.title: The Cell
chapters.summary: Lucien visits; Jurian's eye.

chapters.title: The First Trial
chapters.summary: The worm in the mud trenches.
chapters.gameplay: Gimmick battle: Middengard worm (trench maze, lure and trap).

chapters.title: The Bargain
chapters.summary: Rhysand heals her arm for one week a month; the tattoo.

chapters.title: Chores
chapters.summary: Impossible tasks; Rhysand's 'help'.

chapters.title: Faerie Wine
chapters.summary: Meals appear; Rhysand drugs her with faerie wine at the parties.

chapters.title: The Second Trial
chapters.summary: The riddle and the levers above a chained Lucien.
chapters.gameplay: Gimmick battle: lowering ceiling puzzle. Power Tier 6.

chapters.title: Darkness
chapters.summary: Bleak days before the final trial.

chapters.title: The Last Party
chapters.summary: A stolen moment with Tamlin; Rhysand.
chapters.gameplay: Fade to black where needed.

chapters.title: The Third Trial
chapters.summary: Three kneeling figures, an ash dagger.
chapters.gameplay: Choice-driven trial.

chapters.title: The Answer
chapters.summary: Amarantha breaks Feyre. The answer to the riddle is love.
chapters.gameplay: Final boss: Amarantha.

chapters.title: Through Other Eyes
chapters.summary: Feyre sees through others' eyes as the High Lords act.

chapters.title: Made
chapters.summary: Feyre wakes immortal. 'Let's go home.'
chapters.gameplay: Power Tier 7: Made Fae. Save export for Book 2.
